complete_parameter_locations.matching_contract: All 158 followup command argument vectors and entrypoint paths match at least one full retained step, after only the original runner {repo}/{work} substitutions are reversed. Every numeric literal, argument order and argument count was kept. This comparison does not assert that later queue scope or summary maps equal an older whole queue; restore the recorded historical queue version for every original field.

actual_returns.original_json_bytes_definition: Exact UTF-8 text between the newline after ```json and the newline immediately before its closing ```; neither outer newline is hashed. Whitespace and original numeric spelling are retained by fixed Git restore, never reconstructed through parsed-number serialization.
actual_returns.missing_keys: The original_top_level_keysets table distinguishes an absent field from an explicit JSON null. A null in this index never turns an unknown child result into success or an empty history.
actual_returns.all_original_values_recoverable: For every row restore the whole original file by exact commit/path/Git blob/bytes/SHA, then read the indicated complete JSON fence. This includes all actual input/output records, compact scalar metrics, full original argv, scope, cleanup record, summary_errors, missing_outputs and any failure text without filtering.
actual_returns.raw_scientific_array_boundary: These published compact records did not contain the runner-only full NPZ/arrays/large reports. This archive does not claim those runner-only objects survived or can be recovered from their hashes.
